# looot-signals

> Open-source signal feed: hiring, funding, news and leadership triggers, deduped into a dated feed with an evidence link per signal. Data comes from looot (https://looot.ai), one token, pay per call.

## Run

- Demo, no token: `npm run demo` (web UI on http://localhost:3220) or `npm run signals -- --demo`
- Price only: `npm run signals -- --dry-run`
- Real run: `LOOOT_TOKEN=... npm run signals -- --triggers triggers.yaml --cap 1 --out signals-out`

## Setup

Node 22.12 or newer. `npm install --ignore-scripts`. The CLI reads `LOOOT_TOKEN` from the shell, not from .env.local (create a token in looot Settings, Agent tokens; a funded balance is needed for real runs). Copy triggers.example.yaml to triggers.yaml. Delete data/ after a --demo run. See README headings What you need, Run it with your own data, Spending, Troubleshooting.

## Files

- triggers.example.yaml: the trigger format
- src/lib/sources.ts: the looot endpoints and list prices used
- src/lib/engine.ts: quote, cap, idempotency keys, pending runs
- skills/looot-signals/SKILL.md: Claude Code skill

## Rules

- The cap is per run (`--cap`, default $1). Calls that would cross it are skipped.
- A call still running when waiting stops is "pending", not failed.
- Output: signals-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json, .csv and .md with only the new signals.
